meta.description: Japanese language support for KOReader, modeled after Yomichan. This plugin extends KOReader's built-in dictionary and selection system to support Yomichan-style deinflection and text scanning, allowing for one-tap searches of inflected verbs and multi-character words and phrases. As such, this plugin removes the need for synonym-based deinflection rules for StarDict-converted Japanese dictionaries. You must have at least one Japanese dictionary installed in order for this plugin to work smoothly with Japanese text.
